The d1-omni and kev prompts escape "<|name|>" in the request text with
std::regex_replace. libstdc++ recurses for each char of the name, so a
state of "<|" and 30000 letters overflows the stack of the HTTP thread
and lla
items.summary: A recent update to ggml/llama.cpp addressed an issue where special tokens in prompts could cause stack overflow due to recursive processing by std::regex_replace, improving server stability.
items.summary_detailed: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its code to address an issue with special token escaping in prompts. Specifically, they resolved a problem where recursive calls using std::regex_replace for "<|name|>" tokens could cause a stack overflow when handling long names. This fix enhances the stability and performance of the system, particularly important for handling longer or more complex input texts.
